blocks.text: Yeh chapter ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein. Har short aur long sawal ka jawab us topic ke Roman Urdu lesson mein hai jis se woh talluq rakhta hai (neeche list dekhein).
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

items: Computational thinking zyada tar kis kaam aati hai? (a) Computer games khelna (b) Masle logical tareeqe se hal karna (c) Mazmoon (essays) likhna (d) Tasveerein banana
Masla hal karne ka pehla step kya hai? (a) Code likhna (b) Hal ki jaanch (evaluation) (c) Masle ko pehchanna (d) Masle ko torna
Bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torna kya kehlata hai? (a) Abstraction (b) Decomposition (c) Evaluation (d) Automation
Masle ka step-by-step hal kya kehlata hai? (a) Program (b) Flowchart (c) Algorithm (d) Function
Sirf true ya false values istemal karne wali logic kaun si hai? (a) Predicate logic (b) Fuzzy logic (c) Propositional logic (d) Natural logic
Compound proposition kaun sa hai? (a) (P) (b) (Q) (c) (P∧Q) (d) True
Truth table ka maqsad kya hai? (a) Programs likhna (b) Data store karna (c) Logical expressions ki value nikalna (evaluate karna) (d) Algorithms design karna
Jo proposition kam az kam ek soorat mein sach ho, woh kya kehlata hai? (a) Unsatisfiable (b) Invalid (c) Satisfiable (d) Equivalent
Universal quantifier ka nishaan kaun sa hai? (a) ∃ (b) ⟶ (c) ∧ (d) ∀
Predicate logic zyada tar kis kaam aati hai? (a) Diagrams banana (b) Variables se rishte dikhana (c) Numbers store karna (d) Networks design karna
Computational thinking se kya muraad hai?
Masla hal karne mein computational thinking kyun aham hai?
Problem solving mein decomposition kya hai?
Algorithm kya hai?
Computer science mein logic kya hai?
Proposition kya hai?
Truth values kya hain?
Truth table kya hai?
Propositional satisfiability kya hai?
Predicate logic mein predicate kya hai?
Computational thinking samjhayein aur munasib misalon ke saath masle hal karne mein is ki ahmiyat batayein.
Computational thinking se masla hal karne ke steps bayan karein. Decomposition ko ek misal se samjhayein.
Knowledge representation framework (ilm ko likhne ke dhaanche) ke taur par logic kya hai? Reasoning aur faisla karne mein is ka kirdar samjhayein.
Propositional logic samjhayein. Simple aur compound propositions misalon ke saath batayein.
Truth tables kya hain? Batayein ke truth tables kaise banaye jate hain aur logical expressions ki value nikalne mein kaise istemal hote hain.
Propositional equivalence samjhayein. Batayein ke equivalent logical expressions kaise pehchane jate hain aur equivalence kyun aham hai.
Propositional satisfiability kya hai? Satisfiable aur unsatisfiable propositions misalon ke saath samjhayein.
Predicate logic aur quantifiers samjhayein. Batayein ke predicate logic asal duniya ke maslon par kaise lagayi jati hai.
